findings.message: Review `https://merchant.example/reviews/s-1002` at `$['data']['itemListElement'][1]['pagefront:reviewSubject']` declares `pagefront:reviewSubject` `product` on an Organization review sheet.
findings.remediation: An Organization review sheet carries `seller`-subject reviews only, classified by where they were collected. A review about a product, or a mixed one, stays in the review sheet of the product it was published on.
